description.text: Program Description Mining engineering is a broad profession, which embraces all required activities to facilitate the recovery of valuable minerals and products from the earth’s crust for the benefit of humanity. It is one of the oldest engineering professions, which continues to grow in importance. An adequate supply of mineral products at competitive prices is the life-blood of the continuing growth of industrialized nations and the foundation of the progress for the developing countries. Mining engineering students study the principles and techniques of mineral exploration, and underground and surface mining operations, as well as, mineral processing technologies. Teaching Objectives 1. A sound knowledge in the required basic sciences and engineering fundamentals; 2. Knowledge and experience in the application of engineering principles to the exploitation of earth’s resources and construction of earth (rock) systems in an engineering systems orientation and setting; 3. Ability to solve complex mining and earth systems related problems 4.Capability for team work and decision making; 5.Appreciation of the global role of minerals in the changing world; 6.Desire for continuing education, intellectual and professional development, analysis and creativity; 7. Self confidence and articulation, with high professional and ethical standards. Main Courses Rock mechanics Rock fragmentation Plant and mine design Mine ventilation Surveying Valuation Industrial hygiene Mineral law Mine safety Computing Mineral processing Solution mining and operations research Duration 4 Years Future Career The mining engineering graduate is qualified for positions in engineering, supervision, and research. Mining Engineers typically earn very good salaries. Engineers across the board are renowned to earn high salaries, and Mining Engineers are no exception. They spend many years studying, work hard and often have to make sacrifices in times of time spent away from their families, and for this reason it’s important that they are adequately compensated.

duration.text: The Mining Engineering at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of all pages of your valid passport With main page (photo, passport number &expiration date and name included), blank pages, and stamped pages. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate
